title.zh: 查询毕业要求与学分进度 (DegreeWorks)

guideText.en: Click 'Study Plan' in the top navigation bar
guideText.zh: 点击顶部导航栏的 Study Plan 菜单
点击 DegreeWorks 链接进入毕业审核页面

title.zh: 查看当前学期课表 (Weekly Schedule)

guideText.en: Click 'Course Registration' in the top menu
guideText.zh: 点击顶部导航栏的 Course Registration 菜单

guideText.en: Click 'Weekly Schedule' for your visual timetable
guideText.zh: 点击 Weekly Schedule 查看图形化课表

title.zh: 查询全校开课计划与选课时间 (Master Class Schedule)

guideText.en: Type 'master' into the 'Find a Page' search box on the right
guideText.zh: 在页面右侧的 Find a Page 搜索框中输入 master
点击 Go 按钮开始搜索

guideText.en: Click 'Master Class Schedule' in the results
guideText.zh: 点击搜索结果中的 Master Class Schedule 进入查询页

guideText.en: Click 'Course Registration' in the top menu
guideText.zh: 点击顶部导航栏的 Course Registration 菜单

guideText.en: Click 'Select Term' when you need to choose a term before adding or dropping classes
guideText.zh: 需要先选择学期时，点击 Select Term

guideText.en: Click 'Add or Drop Classes'. On that page, enter the CRN and submit your changes
guideText.zh: 点击 Add or Drop Classes。进入页面后输入 CRN 并提交更改

title.zh: 纸选课程与调整学分申请 (Paper-Add)

guideText.zh: 前往 Course Registration 菜单

guideText.en: Click 'Application for Add/Drop of Non-Web-enabled Course...'
guideText.zh: 点击 Application for Add/Drop of Non-Web-enabled Course...（非网选课程加退选申请）

title.zh: 学生发展活动中央资料库 (CRESDA)

guideText.en: Click 'Student Services' in the top menu
guideText.zh: 点击顶部导航栏的 Student Services 菜单

guideText.en: Click 'Central Repository on Student Development Activities (CRESDA)'
guideText.zh: 点击 Central Repository on Student Development Activities (CRESDA)

title.zh: 搜寻学生助理与校内实习岗位 (Student Helper)

guideText.en: Click 'Student Services' in the top menu
guideText.zh: 点击顶部导航栏的 Student Services 菜单

guideText.en: Click 'Student Helper and Campus Internship Scheme'. After that page loads, open Job Search
guideText.zh: 点击 Student Helper and Campus Internship Scheme。页面加载后，打开 Job Search
